title: Marketing Update - {{T-2d}}
_demo_note: Last week's published WBR. Section order and headings follow templates/wbr-audit-artifact.md, so wbr-prep can copy each section forward 1:1 and quote the prior-week callouts verbatim in the #team-marketing message.
content:
## Summary

MTD through {{T-2d}}: 402 MELs, 67 MQLs (15 inbound demo requests, 37 auto, 15 outbound), 39 SALs, 13 SQLs. MQL to SAL 58.2%. SAL to SQL 33.3%. Active open pipeline: $1.09M across 85 open deals.

## Traffic

### Organic Search

Gains: "incident management platform" 7 to 4, "on-call rotation software" 14 to 11, "postmortem template" 22 to 19. Losses: "alert fatigue" 9 to 13, "MTTR dashboard" 16 to 20, "runbook automation" 11 to 14.

### Channel Mix (users)

Organic sessions 30,100. Paid sessions 9,050. Demo requests 130.

## Project Updates

Owner: Maya Lindqvist.

- 7 on track, 2 at risk, 1 off track.
- Shipping the website repositioning checkpoint this week; pillar page rewrite is next.
- Brand refresh is off track on legal review of the tagline. Target date has moved once.

## Content and Product Marketing

Owner: Priya Natarajan.

- Two topics approved out of review, one sent back for a sharper angle toward platform engineers.
- Runbook guide brief is ready and waiting on calibration review.
- Blocked on topic rulings before committing the next two briefs.

## Website and Design

Owner: Tomas Reyes.

- Webinar hero dither pack delivered, five channel outputs, alt text included.
- Display ad set repainted in the new palette.

## GTM Ops (MOPs / RevOps)

Owner: Scott McKeighen.

- SAL to SQL conversion opened as a MED anomaly and is still open.
- Event registration sync workflow is exiting every enrollment at step 1. Under investigation.
- Enrichment coverage recovered to 95% after last month's dip.

## Challenges

- Legal review is the long pole on Brand refresh.
- Lead scoring 2.0 decay rules are still undocumented.

## Next up

- Confirm whether the lifecycle stage mapping is causing the SAL to SQL dip.
- Publish the on-call fairness webinar landing page.

## Asks

- Sales leadership: 15 minutes on how SAL is being accepted in practice.

## Notes

- Definitions are locked at v1.5. No restatements this week.
